Sean / Marissa — quick technical summary from my side so procurement understands the risk profile:

- Data flow: We'll run Outreach in parallel with HubSpot for the pilot using the existing HubSpot-Outreach connector. We'll route messages from the pilot SDR cohort to a separate Outreach workspace to limit cross-environment noise.
- Contact dedupe: We will enable de-duplication rules at the connector layer and configure a contact canonicalization policy. That will prevent spikes in contact counts for billing, but procurement/legal should note that historical activity will be associated with both systems during the pilot window.
- Export/backups: We'll take daily exports of activity events and store them in a secure S3 bucket (retention 90 days) to satisfy audit and transition needs.

Risk mitigation asks for vendor:
1) Outreach to guarantee no incremental contact billing for the pilot cohort beyond seats provisioned.
2) A short SOW clause stating data portability procedures post-pilot.

If Lena can confirm those two points, we're comfortable moving on staged PO terms.

—Soojin
Director, Sales Operations
